_comment: Bounties and scouting (the bounty board in the guild hall; also through the clerk) and requests (plaza notice board). See game/work.py. All numbers are PLACEHOLDERS. board_every: Pulses between new boards and new requests (81 = a Reckon: about one hunt and its rest). jobs_on_board: postings on the bounty board. Each is at a place (three keywords) of a danger picked by danger_weights (rank decides which a Hunter may take): kill (a bounty on one marked creature, the toughest kind the place's deepest area allows; reward = kill_base + kill_per_tier x tier + per_danger x danger), find (a bounty on a particular broken artifact, waiting in the place's deepest area; reward = its rarity's broken price x find_reward + per_danger x danger; hand it to the clerk), or scout (reach an area of the place; reward = scout_base + scout_per_area x area + per_danger x danger). kill_chance and find_chance: how often each kind is posted; the rest are scouting. The Guild pays them and takes no dues from that pay. Requests: requesters are townsfolk ids; request_rarities weights which rarities are asked for; specific_chance = how often they want one named kind (it must be identified to hand over) rather than any of a rarity; reward = the working value x specific_reward, or the broken price x rarity_reward; each stands request_days Pulses. Material requests: material_chance = how often a request asks for materials instead of an artifact; material_counts = how many of each material can be asked for [least, most]; reward = the material's value x count x material_reward. Errands (v0.47.0; user: townsfolk requests that send the Hunter to a place; hearing of one, on the notice board or from the person, teaches its words): errand_chance = how often a request is one; errand_dangers = the dangers picked from; the artifact waits in the place's deepest area, and pays its rarity's broken price x errand_reward + per_danger x danger (no identifying needed). bounty_pay (balance pass 3, user, v0.62.0): every bounty and scouting reward is multiplied by it (0.6: cut by 40%). Fish (v0.100.0, fishing stage 6): "Fresh catch wanted". fish_only: townsfolk who only ever ask for fish (the fishmonger); fish_requesters may ask for one, at fish_chance. The fish is a kind up to fish_max_tier from the city or the Brisering (not one kept to some Pulses or the holidays); at fish_heavy_chance it must weigh at least its usual weight. Reward = its worth at that weight x fish_reward + 4 x tier, at least fish_least. Hand it over by talking to whoever asked; it counts as fishing income.
